stem: Cattermole Systems has a `data` block whose only filter value comes from an attribute of a resource this same plan is scheduled to change. What happens to that data block's read?

choices.text: Terraform halts planning entirely until the referenced resource finishes changing outside this run
Terraform defers reading the data source until the apply phase
Terraform reads the data source immediately during planning
Terraform rejects the configuration, treating a data block that references a changing resource as invalid

rationale: Terraform may defer reading a data source until apply specifically when its arguments depend on a resource this same plan is about to change. It doesn't halt the whole plan waiting on an out-of-band change, it doesn't read ahead of the pending change and report a stale value, and referencing a resource under change is ordinary configuration, not an invalid one.
